name: app-chat-image-sharing-and-full-screen-preview-screens
title: Two phones: chat thread with shared lake photos and a full-screen image preview
whatItIs: Two phone frames on white titled 'Chat Screens — Image Sharing & Preview': a chat with a user header, 'Today' chip, a sent photo in a purple bubble and a received photo in grey, and a dark full-screen preview of the mountain lake photo with share and delete actions.
whatItMeans: Clean and practical; one purple accent marks your own messages while photos stay the hero.
techniques: Frame sent media in the accent colour and received in grey.
Switch to a dark chrome for full-screen media.
Keep header and composer icons minimal.
Title paired screens as a flow.

vocabulary.definition: A chat bubble that holds an image.
A full-screen overlay for viewing media.
